name: Sacred Grove
description: Hold block to grow a blessed circle of grass that grants holy gifts.

displayLines.label: Level 2: robe and a healing cross

details:
Hold block to grow a circle of grass under you (about 8 seconds at base stats; you can't move or shoot while charging). Flowers bloom when the circle is complete, and it stays until the blessing is done. Keep charging inside it for 3 levels; the circle glows brighter with each one.

Let go and the charge drains back quickly, but not at once: step back in and hold block to carry on.

Level 1: a holy shield surrounds you for 10 seconds, soaking damage worth half your max health.
Level 2: you're dressed in a priest's robe and a cross falls from the sky into the circle. Standing near it heals you steadily for 30 seconds.
Level 3: an angel comes down and circles you for the rest of the round, healing you all the time. It has its own shield bubble like the Turret's; if it's destroyed, it flies up to heaven.

A soft choir hums while you charge. Charging speed comes from Block cooldown and Block duration; Block size makes the circle bigger. No block bubble.
